quarterly_data.quarter: Accretech (Tokyo Seimitsu) annual securities report: FY2026 (06-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Fiscal year ended March 31, 2026 (annual securities report): record net sales of JPY 166,839 million (+10.8%), operating income JPY 33,738 million (+13.6%), ordinary income JPY 34,825 million (+16.3%), profit attributable to owners of the parent JPY 24,739 million (-3.5%) after an extraordinary loss of JPY 1,833 million for countermeasures against a defect in some semiconductor manufacturing equipment products (booked in Q2). Segments: Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment net sales JPY 127,878 million (+12.7%), operating income JPY 28,404 million (+16.8%); Metrology Equipment net sales JPY 38,960 million (+5.1%), operating income JPY 5,333 million (-1.1%). Cost of sales was 58.7% of net sales (58.5% a year earlier) and SG&A 21.1% (21.8%). Management states that rising AI and technology capex lifted demand related to HPC including generative AI, and that the impact of the worsening Middle East situation on the year was minor.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 166,839 million (+10.8%); operating income JPY 33,738 million (+13.6%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Accretech (Tokyo Seimitsu) annual securities report: FY2026 (06-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment, FY ended March 2026 (annual securities report): orders rose year on year as inquiries for probers for HBM (High Bandwidth Memory) and for grinders for AI packaging processes stayed firm throughout the year and demand for high-precision equipment in China continued. Sales set a record as shipments broadly met customer-requested delivery dates and shipments of high value-added probers increased. By region, probers were firm in Korea, Taiwan and China, and processing equipment such as grinders and dicers in Taiwan, China and Japan.

quarterly_data.quarter: Accretech (Tokyo Seimitsu) annual securities report: FY2026 (06-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Outlook (management's analysis, annual securities report): management expects the Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment business to remain generally firm, expecting the expansion of HPC-related equipment including generative AI to continue and customer investment to expand production of general-purpose memory and of logic semiconductors including ASICs to accelerate. As devices advance, technical requirements are rising especially for probers (test equipment), and management expects the shipment ratio of high value-added products to rise. The company will strengthen overseas demo-center facilities, build a new plant near its Hanno plant (Saitama), which makes the test equipment, and prepare a new production site in Hachioji (Tokyo) in view of long-term demand growth. For Metrology Equipment, management sees the slower-than-expected shift to NEVs as a headwind for the rapid spread of charge/discharge test systems, expects capex tied to the return to hybrid vehicles to accelerate along with inquiries from aerospace/defense, energy and the semiconductor equipment industry, and assumes a gradual growth trend overall.

quarterly_data.quarter: Accretech (Tokyo Seimitsu) annual securities report: FY2026 (06-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capex and plant plans (annual securities report): capex for the year ended March 2026 was JPY 11,069 million - Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment JPY 7,224 million, including a JPY 972 million deposit to acquire land for the new Hachioji plant and JPY 1,115 million for a demo center at the Korean subsidiary; Metrology Equipment JPY 3,844 million, including JPY 947 million of plant renovation to expand the battery-evaluation contract service. The Nagoya plant, built for long-term growth in processing-equipment demand, was completed during the year and increased production capacity. Planned: a new Hanno plant (Saitama; land and buildings, Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment; amount undecided) starting construction in May 2026 for completion in March 2028; a new Hachioji plant (Tokyo; land and buildings; JPY 952 million spent so far, total and schedule undecided); and an ACCRETECH KOREA demo center in Hwaseong, Gyeonggi (JPY 4,515 million planned, JPY 2,849 million spent; March 2026 to May 2027). The company says the capacity increase is difficult to quantify.
quarterly_data.figure: Capex JPY 11,069 million; new Hanno plant May 2026 - March 2028

quarterly_data.quarter: Accretech (Tokyo Seimitsu) annual securities report: FY2026 (06-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D (annual securities report): group R&D expenses were JPY 12,037 million in the year ended March 2026 - Semiconductor Manufacturing Equipment JPY 9,254 million (main themes: performance improvement, process development and new models of probing machines, wafer dicing machines and grinding equipment, as stacking and miniaturization raise demands for high-precision processing and inspection and higher throughput); Metrology Equipment JPY 2,782 million (improvement of precision measuring instruments and development of charge/discharge test systems).
